civilopediaText.text: Unfocused source of magical power. An Adept may attune this resource with a sphere-specific Mana Node improvement after learning the corresponding school of magic. The resulting improvement supplies one sphere Mana resource to your empire. Raw Mana does not itself grant a spell or sphere promotion.

Air Mana is gathered from a Air Node on an improved Raw Mana tile. It is an empire-wide strategic resource reserved for future Air sphere spell and promotion requirements; merely owning it does not yet grant spells.
